title: Unit – 4 : Session – 1 : SLO – 2  |  Control Unit — Fill in the Blanks
sections: 1. Control Unit (CU) — decodes instructions and generates control signals.
2. Program Counter (PC) — holds the address of the next instruction to be executed.
3. Instruction Register (IR) — temporarily stores the instruction fetched from memory.
4. Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) — performs arithmetic and logical operations in the CPU.
5. clock (clock signal) — synchronizes the operations of the CPU components.
6. microoperations — the small, atomic steps used to execute an instruction.
7. pipelining — overlaps instruction execution for better performance.
8. Control Unit (control signal generator) — generates signals to control data movement and ALU operations.
9. accumulator — the register that holds intermediate results during processing.
10. fetch — the fetch step retrieves the instruction from memory into the CPU.
